To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) We have designed and implemented a scalable, high-performance system for active DNS measurements that can collect data for the entire DNS of a large TLD in a single day.

we have designed a scalable system to perform daily active measurements for 123M domains and we have used this system to measure the DNS for the largest TDL (.com) and the second largest TDL (.net) on a daily basis for over 3 years, collecting over 1 billion DNS responses.

(1) the design of the system we built allows it to scale to a large measurement of the entire DNS name space, (2) it is designed to minimize the impact of the measurement on the DNS, and (3) it provides a unique and valuable data set that we have released publicly.
